        'exp_year': 2030,
        'metadata': {'brand': 'visa'},
    },
    'billing': {
        'name': 'Zoe\u0308 Okonkwo',
        'address': {'line1': '12 Harbor St', 'postal_code': '94107'},
    },
    'token_policy': {'ttl': 3600},
}


def test_base_payload_valid():
